data.name: GitInitDialogMessage
data.value:
To show what the agent changes, AgentTrace Studio uses git. I can run in the project folder:
git init
Without a repository the Inspector only shows the files that the trace says were edited, without a diff. If there is no commit, the whole project would appear as new: you can also create a first commit.
data.comment: Body of the git init dialog. Keep the line breaks and the indented command.
